_meta.status: v1.2 — GT rule = EXACT + DESCENDANT (related-only NOT fit), uniform across families (OC reconcile round-4)
_meta.expect_semantics: cases[].expect lists canonical dataset IDs (NOT title substrings). Discovery PASSES if expected IDs appear in top-k. abstain=true => engine must return none-fit. fitnessExpect={datasetId,verdict} scores C3 against the owner's deterministic verdict.
_meta.ground_truth_rule: fit(d,t) <=> d declares t OR a descendant of t in task-vocabulary hierarchy. related-only = unfit. Identical to engine taskIdMatch after the `related` clause is dropped.
